agenda_items.section: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Mayor Toor called the regular April 3, 2001 meeting of the Boulder City Council to order at 6:00 p.m. in the Council Chambers.

agenda_items.title: CITIZEN PARTICIPATION
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council heard citizen participation and staff responses.

agenda_items.title: CONSENT AGENDA
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved Consent Agenda items 3-A through 3-C, 9-0.

agenda_items.title: APPROVAL OF THE CITY COUNCIL MEETING MINUTES FROM MARCH 20, 2001.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved Consent Agenda items 3-A through 3-C, 9-0.

agenda_items.title: ACCEPTANCE OF SUMMARY FROM FEBRUARY 13, 2001 JOINT STUDY SESSION WITH THE PARKS AND RECREATION ADVISORY BOARD REGARDING THE VALMONT CITY PARK.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved Consent Agenda items 3-A through 3-C, 9-0.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION AUTHORIZING THE PURCHASE OF APPROXIMATELY 64.5 ACRES IN FEE, ALONG WITH 20 SHARES OF LEFT HAND DITCH COMPANY WATER FROM SILVANO AND ELVIRA DELUCA FOR $1,395,000.00 FOR OPEN SPACE AND MOUNTAIN PARKS' PURPOSES.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved Consent Agenda items 3-A through 3-C, 9-0.

agenda_items.title: MATTERS FROM THE CITY MANAGER
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Reviewed the implementation report for the University Hill Action Group recommendations. Announced that the next report would be on July 3rd.

agenda_items.title: STATUS REPORT ON IMPLEMENTATION OF THE UNIVERSITY HILL ACTION GROUP (UHAG) RECOMMENDATIONS.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Reviewed the implementation report for the University Hill Action Group recommendations. Announced that the next report would be on July 3rd.

agenda_items.title: MATTERS FROM THE CITY ATTORNEY
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council recommended a discussion on Council Committee Meeting Notice and voted to table the Loftus proposal motion to April 17, 2001.

agenda_items.title: Announced that the draft form of the City Trash ordinance is on the City Attorney website.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Announced that the draft form of the City Trash ordinance is on the City Attorney website.

agenda_items.title: Council Committee Meeting Notice. Council recommended that CAC set a date for a Council discussion on this issue.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council recommended that CAC set a date for a Council discussion on this issue.

agenda_items.title: Regarding the Loftus proposal in North Boulder, as one of the property owners the city must take action to allow the concept review process to move forward.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council voted 5-4 to table the motion concerning the Loftus proposal to the April 17, 2001 City Council meeting.

agenda_items.section: MATTERS FROM THE MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF COUNCIL
agenda_items.title: MATTERS FROM THE MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF COUNCIL
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council took no action on the potential call-ups and made CATV appointments.

agenda_items.section: MATTERS FROM THE MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF COUNCIL
agenda_items.title: POTENTIAL CALL-UPS:
agenda_items.outcome_summary: No action was taken on these items.

agenda_items.outcome_summary: No action was taken on this item.

agenda_items.outcome_summary: No action was taken on this item.

agenda_items.section: MATTERS FROM THE MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF COUNCIL
agenda_items.title: CONTINUED ANNUAL APPOINTMENTS TO BOARDS AND COMMISSIONS - CATV
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Adam Samuel Roth and Peter Gowen were appointed to two year terms, and Council requested that additional applicants be approached and considered at the April 17 th meeting.

agenda_items.title: PUBLIC COMMENT
agenda_items.outcome_summary: None.

agenda_items.title: FINAL DECISIONS
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Vote was taken on the motion to approve Consent Agenda Items 3-A through 3-C. The motion carried:9-0.

agenda_items.title: INTRODUCTION, FIRST READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ORDER PUBLISHED BY TITLE ONLY AN ORDINANCE APPROVING AND AUTHORIZING THE ISSUANCE OF BOULDER MUNICIPAL PROPERTY AUTHORITY LEASE PURCHASE REVENUE NOTE, SERIES 2001B, IN THE AGGREGATE PRINCIPAL AMOUNT OF $580,000.00, AND APPROVING AND AUTHORIZING A LEASE PURCHASE AGREEMENT FOR THE PURCHASE OF APPROXIMATELY 39 ACRES IN FEE TOGETHER WITH ALL MINERAL RIGHTS AND 30 SHARES OF LEFT HAND DITCH COMPANY WATER, HESTER RESERVOIR AND COUGHLIN DITCH LOCATED NORTH OF NEBO ROAD BETWEEN FOOTHILLS HIGHWAY AND NORTH 39 TH STREET FROM THE HESTER FAMILY TRUST FOR OPEN SPACE AND MOUNTAIN PARKS' PURPOSES.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council adopted and ordered published by title only Ordinance No. 7124, 9-0.

agenda_items.title: INTRODUCTION, FIRST READING, AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ORDER PUBLISHED BY TITLE ONLY TWO ORDINANCES:
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved first reading of Ordinance No. 7125 and Ordinance No. 7126, each 9-0.

agenda_items.title: ADOPTING A NEW SECTION 5-4-16, B.R.C. 1981, CONCERNING THE PROHIBITION OF THE USE OF INDOOR FURNITURE IN AN OUTDOOR LOCATION.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council amended, adopted and ordered published by title only Ordinance No. 7125, 9-0.

agenda_items.title: ADOPTING A NEW SECTION 5-3-11, B.R.C. 1981, CONCERNING NUISANCE PARTIES.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council adopted and ordered published by title only Ordinance No. 7126, 9-0.

agenda_items.title: INTRODUCTION, FIRST READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ORDER PUBLISHED BY TITLE ONLY AN EMERGENCY AMENDMENT TO EXISTING ORDINANCE #7032 CONCERNING THE MODIFICATION OF THE WATER AND SANITARY SEWER SERVICE ORDINANCE WITH THE BOULDER VALLEY SCHOOL DISTRICT SETTING FORTH THE PROVISION OF SUCH SERVICES TO THE NEW ENVIRONMENTAL EDUCATION FACILITY BEING CONSTRUCTED AT SOMBRERO MARSH, 6500 E. ARAPAHOE AVENUE.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council introduced and ordered published by title only Ordinance No. 7127, 9-0.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Corson, to approve Consent Agenda items 3-A through 3-C.

Councilmember Corson moved, seconded by Lopez to allow the Concept review process to proceed for the Loftus proposal with clarification that the Council is not taking any position regarding the project proposal.
Councillemmber Halvic moved, seconded by Eldridge, to table the prior motion to the April 17, 2001 City Council meeting.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 5-4. Corson, Lopez, Poinsatte and Toor opposed.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Morzel, to adopt and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7124 approving and authorizing the issuance of Boulder Municipal Property Authority lease Purchase Revenue Note, Series 2001B, in the aggregate principal amount of $580,000.00, and approving and authorizing a Lease Purchase Agreement for the purchase of approximately 39 acres in fee together with all mineral rights and 30 shares of left hand Ditch Company water, Hester Reservoir and Coughlin Ditch located north of Nebo Road between Foothills Highway and North 39 th Street from the Hester Family Trust for Open Space and Mountain Parks' purposes.
Councilmember Havlick moved, seconded by Corson, to amend, adopt and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7125 concerning the prohibition of the use of indoor furniture in an outdoor location.
Councilmember Havlick moved, seconded by Corson, to adopt and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7126 concerning nuisance parties.

Councilmember Morzel moved, seconded by Eldridge, to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7127 an Emergency Amendment to existing Ordinance #7032 concerning the modification of the water and sanitary sewer service ordinance with the Boulder Valley School District setting forth the provision of such services to the new environmental education facility being constructed at Sombrero Marsh, 6500 E. Arapahoe Avenue.
There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 8:45 p.m.

open_comment_speakers.name: Michael Kennedy
open_comment_speakers.topic: 50 year resident who was appalled by the lewd language and graphic behavior being purported on Public Access T.V. Channel 54.

open_comment_speakers.name: Brian Hanley
open_comment_speakers.topic: furniture and nuisance party ordinances. Opposed to proposed ordinances as he felt they set a dangerous precedent for a problem that only exists in one area of the city.

open_comment_speakers.name: Rob Smoke
open_comment_speakers.topic: Vinyl Slipcovers. Opposed to prohibiting outdoor couches. Also spoke in opposition to a Super Target at Crossroads.

open_comment_speakers.name: Terry Rodrigue
open_comment_speakers.topic: Spoke on behalf of University Hill neighborhood renovation - re: Aloha Trash program- spoke in support, noting that this will be a critical element in cleaning up "the hill."

open_comment_speakers.name: Eleanor DePuy
open_comment_speakers.topic: also a University Hill resident speaking in favor of the Aloha program (attachment).

open_comment_speakers.name: Doug Crigler
open_comment_speakers.topic: Goss-Grove Neighborhood Association. Spoke on behalf of association in support of the nuisance ordinance and in very strong support of the sofa ordinance.

open_comment_speakers.name: Kenneth Wilson
open_comment_speakers.topic: Also a member of the University Hill Neighborhood Association - applauded police enforcement efforts and supports both the sofa ordinance and the nuisance party ordinance.

open_comment_speakers.name: Bob McFarland
open_comment_speakers.topic: Pearl Street Mall 1) Don't mess with the sales tax and 2) keep the grass on the mall.

open_comment_speakers.name: Lynn Segal
open_comment_speakers.topic: commented on the guest opinion editorial by Steve Fisher. Spoke in support of his suggestions. Also opposed to the sofa ordinance and Rocky Flats designation as a wildlife refuge (should be treated as a toxic waste site).

open_comment_speakers.name: Edward Riedel
open_comment_speakers.topic: Boulder Community Velodrome. Encouraged that a letter of interest be issued to allow process to move forward.

open_comment_speakers.name: Stephen Pomerance
open_comment_speakers.topic: concerns with the Comp Plan update process.

open_comment_speakers.name: Ruth Blackmore
open_comment_speakers.topic: Taggart Phase A report on South Boulder Creek Floodplain. The study is flawed and should not move on to Phase B. Announced that the County Commissioners rejected all options in the Phase A Taggart Report at today's hearing.

open_comment_speakers.name: Crystal Gray
open_comment_speakers.topic: presented a slide show on the Open Space purchases currently listed on the Consent Agenda.

open_comment_speakers.name: Ron Forthofer
open_comment_speakers.topic: spoke in opposition to removing any trees or grass on the Pearl Street Mall.
